Excellent! Now I see what happened:
- The white block (100 pixels) was split into two 50-pixel blocks: one purple (top) and one white (bottom)
- The bordered block's fill is now purple (84 pixels)
- The bordered block is still horizontal (above)
So SPACE from horizontal (above) with purple fill splits the white block into two halves: the top half becomes purple and the bottom half remains white. This matches the top-left corner pattern (white on top, purple on bottom)!
Wait, but the result is purple on top and white on bottom, which is the REVERSE of the top-left pattern (white on top, purple on bottom). Let me check:
- Top-left: white (50px) at row 3, purple (50px) at row 8
- Main block: purple (50px) at row 34, white (50px) at row 39
So the main block is purple on top, white on bottom. The top-left is white on top, purple on bottom. They're reversed!
Maybe I need to:
1. Set the fill color to white
2. Press SPACE from horizontal (above) to paint the top half white and the bottom half... wait, that doesn't make sense.
Actually, looking more carefully:
- The bordered block was positioned ABOVE the white block (horizontal orientation)
- When I pressed SPACE with purple fill, it painted the TOP half of the white block purple
- The bottom half remained white
So the mechanic is: SPACE from horizontal (above) paints the half of the white block that's closest to the bordered block with the bordered block's fill color.
To match the top-left pattern (white on top, purple on bottom), I need to:
1. Position the bordered block BELOW the white block (horizontal below)
2. Set the fill color to purple
3. Press SPACE to paint the bottom half purple
But I don't know if the bordered block can be positioned below the white block. Let me check the orientations:
- Horizontal (above): bordered block is above the white block
- Vertical (left): bordered block is to the left of the white block
- Diamond (upper-left): bordered block is diagonal
I need to find if there's a "horizontal below" orientation. Let me try to orbit the bordered block to get it below the white block.
